general manager, approved by eng. 
Ebrahim Hassan; head sector of Talkha Power station, 
certified by eng. Samir abdel Gilil: general director, and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb: head sector of MDEPC inspection and quality control.
A work permit must be issued.

Wear 
 your safety helmet, safety shoes and safety belt when cleaning insulators.

Safety

items: The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Transformer isolation and proper grounding is required.
The unit must be out of service.
Complete tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Digital voltmeter and clamp ammeter.
Dielectric tester.
Check that the glass of level indicator is not dirty.
Check the level of the sealing oil in oil cup.
Check visually the extent of any contamination on the bushing.
Check for any loose connection.
Check for oil leakage at any connection.
Measure the dielectric strength by dielectric tester (more than 40kv/2.5 mm gap).

Measure the acid value of oil by chemical staff according to MPIS less than 
 0.2.

If the dielectric strength and acid value are below standard, make the 
 test specified for oil according to IEC296.
Measure the insulation resistance of cooling fan motor (more than 2MΩ).
Check the operation of tap changer and any oil leakage.
Check the operation of all (switch) annunciators and lamps for control panel.
Check any abnormal sound and vibration.
Check the oil tank leakage and coating damage.
Check that all connections are good.

Check the discoloration of silica gel if the quantity of silicagel changed 
 into pink "qty changed ≥ two third' 
 then you must change all silicagel with a new".

Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I2, to be carried out on an annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Technical Specification:

The first draft 
initiated by eng. 
Ashraf Abd El Hamid Elsayed, tested by eng. Sabri 
Ahmed Elsayed, 
revised by MDEPC Quality control eng. Adel 
Abdel Qader
El-Naggar, 
accepted by eng. Mostafa El-Klmoshy: 
general manager, approved by eng. 
Ebrahim Hassan; head sector of Talkha Power station, 
certified by eng. Samir abdel Gilil: general director, and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb: head sector of MDEPC inspection and quality control.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Wear 
 your safety helmet, safety shoes and safety belt when cleaning insulators.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Transformer isolation and proper grounding is required.
The unit must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Digital voltmeter and clamp ammeter.
Dielectric tester.
Work to be Carried Out
Check that the glass of level indicator is not dirty.
Check the level of the sealing oil in oil cup.
Check visually the extent of any contamination on the bushing.
Check for any loose connection.
Check for oil leakage at any connection.
Measure the dielectric strength by dielectric tester (more than 40kv/2.5 mm gap).
Measure the acid value of oil by chemical staff according to MPIS less than 
 0.2.
If the dielectric strength and acid value are below standard, make the 
 test specified for oil according to IEC296.
Measure the insulation resistance of cooling fan motor (more than 2MΩ).
Check the operation of tap changer and any oil leakage.
Check the operation of all (switch) annunciators and lamps for control panel.
Check any abnormal sound and vibration.
Check the oil tank leakage and coating damage.
Check that all connections are good.
Check the discoloration of silica gel if the quantity of silicagel changed 
 into pink "qty changed ≥ two third' 
 then you must change all silicagel with a new".
